app.title: OFF42 web app
app.privacy: Files are opened and converted in this browser tab by the OFF42 engine (WebAssembly). Nothing is uploaded: this page makes no network requests after it has loaded.
app.limitsText: Documents, spreadsheets and presentations cannot be exported to PDF, PDF pages are not displayed, presentations are shown as a text outline, and stamps support Latin, Cyrillic and Greek text only. Messages from the engine are in English. The desktop apps for Mac and Windows have the full feature set.

stamp.fonts: Stamps here use the bundled Noto Sans font (Latin, Cyrillic, Greek). Templates in other scripts need system fonts that a browser does not expose. Template names are in English, Russian or Turkish; categories and field names are in English.
